newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's August budget deficit 2.089 bln shekels.
newsitem.headline: Israel's August budget deficit 2.089 bln shekels.

text.p: Israel posted a budget deficit of 2.089 billion shekels in August, preliminary figures from the Treasury show.
Note: Figures are in millions of shekels.
Treasury officials said most of the deficit in August was due to lower receipts.
In August the government raised a net 569 million shekels from the public. Since the beginning of the year the government raised 3.4 billion shekels from the public, including through privatisation.
The government had a deficit of 8.6 billion shekels in the first eight months of the year. Expenditures for this period totalled 80.6 billion shekels and receipts 72 billion shekels.
